data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘salax’, meaning tranquil or calm. In ancient Greece, Salaidh was believed to be a goddess of peace and serenity. In Christian tradition, Salaidh represents the inner calm and peace found through faith. The name Salaidh carries the meaning “Peaceful, calm” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Salaidh usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
